environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on AWS EC2 (m5.large) in us-east-1, running behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). EC2 instance has IAM role with S3 and DynamoDB access. IMDSv1 enabled (HttpTokens: optional). No network-level egress filtering. Security group allows all outbound traffic. The ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated.

config.network: VPC with IGW, no egress restrictions, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0 outbound
config.load_balancer: ALB with default forwarding rule, no WAF WebACL
